label: HAS_INTELLECT_1 and HAS_WILL_1 by governor identity
meaning: Analyst horizontal support option for the existing positive-root endpoint, attribution deferred. Retains the twelve other inputs of PerfectRootPositiveIntellectWill.derive and replaces the universal immateriality-to-intellect premise with the existing MaximeEnsGovernsNature endpoint, instantiated with ONE HasIntellect predicate for the Fifth-Way Intelligent parameter and HAS_INTELLECT_1. This explicit dictionary application remains a semantic burden: understanding ends must instantiate intellectual cognition, rather than merely sensory response or biological benefit; no equivalence of arbitrary predicates is derived. Unpack the supplied perfect actual root n and intelligent maximum d. If d differs from n, the maximum-in-being causal policy gives d an esse-cause edge to n (which has esse). EsseCauseIsActualConcreteGround turns that edge into a ground of the SAME actual concretum n, contradicting its roothood. Hence d=n and HasIntellect transports to n. The existing uniting-cause, composition-kind, priority, no-component, goodness and transfer policies then give the SAME positive-root tuple, and the existing will principle gives HasWill n. The governor need not first be shown a root, and no all-maxima uniqueness axiom, God-name, universal immateriality bridge, cognitive grade transfer or actual form-acquisition event is assumed. Perfect-root existence and the complete conditional provenance of the intelligent-governor endpoint remain separate obligations. No unconditional existence of God, premise truth, rival defeat or root closure follows. The old universal/direct-assumption route is retained. Exact research comparison, positive teleological rationale, naturalistic organizational/consumer rival and missing application evidence are in docs/immaterial-intellect-reception.md#horizontal-support-same-root-through-an-intelligent-governor-2026-11-17.

strong_version_needed.d7741cdc-881b-5bda-85ce-d70223162f78: The proof uses the second conjunct (And.right): a being whose esse differs from its essence is composite (in top), to exclude a distinct esse in a being known not to be composite. The weak version MatterFormIsComposite (6a9199b7) is only the matter–form conjunct.
strong_version_needed.cb1cdea9-eb6c-578c-8008-84e0d4107fd3: The premise is applied to a cause whose actual concreteness is not otherwise available: a maximum in esse (maximumEqualsRoot, actualRootMaximum), the uniting or external cause of a supposed composite or distinct-esse root, or an arbitrary given cause or prior. The proof relies on the premise's output that this cause is concrete and exists at w (ActualConcreteGround c x), either to contradict rootness or as part of the conclusion. The weak version ActualEsseCauseIsActualGround (b17a8954) assumes ActualConcrete c and yields only grounds w c x.
strong_version_needed.ee4ab504-c8fe-59bc-bc96-7cbeefed6410: The proof applies excluded middle to `d = n` (in maximumEqualsActualRootAtBeing), an identity question about a maximum and an actual root (d = n), where neither side is given as a GOD_4 candidate. LocalLogic (ca432e24) decides only whether an actual bearer is identical with a GOD_4 candidate, and gives double-negation elimination for that candidate's esse–essence identity.
